# Commands

Every slash command this bot registers, for developers: where it is defined, what it
takes, who may run it, and what it reads and writes. Members' and staff's guides to the
same commands are in the FZD docs.

## Event setup

### `/event_setup`

Set up an event's slots and scoring, and the posts that announce it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/cogs/hostpost_commands.py:65`](../src/cogs/hostpost_commands.py#L65) |
| Usage | `/event_setup <event>` |
| Checks in code | `has_any_role` |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Circuit Crew and Admin |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #playground, #fzd-events. Admin also: #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | API: `GET /v1/events` (choices), `GET /v1/events/{id}`, `GET /v1/ingame/rotation`, `GET /v1/ingame/lineups`, `GET /v1/lineups`; at Confirm, `PUT /v1/events/{id}/scoring` then `PUT /v1/events/{id}/schedule`. MySQL directly: post templates from `event_messages`, the event's host. |
| Side effects | Queues the posts in APScheduler and `bot.job_stack`, plus `getResults_<event>` and, with a host persona, `hostUpdate_<event>`. Posts the drafts and a text file in the channel. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event` | text | yes |  | yes | The event to set up, from the calendar of upcoming events. |

## Results

### `/post_prix_winner`

Add the winner to a prix result post, and post it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/cogs/autopost_commands.py:374`](../src/cogs/autopost_commands.py#L374) |
| Usage | `/post_prix_winner <job_name> [winner_1] [winner_2] [winner_string]` |
| Checks in code | `has_any_role` |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Circuit Crew and Admin |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #playground, #fzd-events. Admin also: #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | The post's text in `bot.job_stack`. |
| Side effects | Replaces `@[Player]` with the winners and resumes the paused job, which posts in the engagement channel. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_name` | text | yes |  | yes | The prix result post waiting for its winner. |
| `winner_1` | server member | no |  |  | The winner. |
| `winner_2` | server member | no |  |  | A second winner, for a tie. |
| `winner_string` | text | no |  |  | A winner typed as text, for someone you can't pick as a member. |

### `/validate_results`

Post an event's final results and close it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`src/cogs/autopost_commands.py:432`](../src/cogs/autopost_commands.py#L432) |
| Usage | `/validate_results <event_name>` |
| Checks in code | `has_any_role` |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Circuit Crew and Admin |
| Where | #f-zero99-racetrack, #playground, #fzd-events. Admin also: #fzd-machine |
| Reads and writes | The in-memory scheduler and `bot.job_stack`. |
| Side effects | Resumes the event's `FinalResults` job, which posts in the announcement channel, then removes the event's other jobs. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event_name` | text | yes |  | yes | The event whose final results are waiting. |
